name: Repair Jammer - Dodge
RelatedDescription: An engineering backpack fitted with a high-precision robotic arm that provides professional repairs on the battlefield. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's Dodge capability.

61232.name: Repair Device I · Dodge
61232.SpecificEffects:
When the action starts, repair yourself <color=#F74848>once</color>, restoring HP equal to <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. This cannot repair damaged parts.
In combat, the enemy's Dodge Rate <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
